title: Gahori Lai Xaak
body:
Gahori Lai Xaak is pork cooked with lai xaak, mustard greens. The greens are wilted into the pork gravy, adding a mild bitterness and a dark green colour.

How it is made and served

The pork is cooked first, then the mustard greens are added and simmered until soft. It is a common winter dish in Assamese homes, served with rice.
